fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO) posted 1% return over one year, lagging the semiconductor index's 48% gain, yet is excessively undervalued on intrinsic basis: AI semiconductor revenue expected to surge from $58B in 2026 to $115B in 2027 to $230B in 2028.
fields.summary_ko.1: Broadcom's forward P/E of 18x is cheaper than Nasdaq 100 at 21x; optical networking components market expected to grow tenfold from $15B in 2026 to $154B in 2028.
